thread:
ana: thanks for the all-hands. opening a short follow-up for the customer wins/losses segment  post clarifying q's or asks for leadership here and i'll route.

matt: field ask  can we get per-route cost breakdowns surfaced in the console? AEs are pushing for it.

ana: product is scoping per-route billing export + API. aiming for Q2 beta but not committed.

leah: sales win highlight: fallback-routing + regional failover demo closed a strategic account. can we make a one-pager + a sample YAML snippet for AE decks?

sam: +1. loss theme: quantized model regressions caused hallucinations in one POC. need a clear preflight checklist and guidance on when to pin variants.

priya: i can draft a short eval checklist: golden prompts, token-diff check, latency-smoke, and sample edge cases. happy to own first pass.

derek: partner ask: per-tenant KV cache controls + eviction hooks. blocking a partner POC. product/infra please advise priority.

jordan: infra needs an anonymized billing-event sample to build the export pipeline. @matt can you drop a sanitized CSV to the shared drive?

matt: will upload sanitized sample by EOD.

zara: quick for leadership  whats our handoff rule between solutions-eng and SE for POCs? field teams say the handoffs are inconsistent.

ana: interim rule: solutions-eng owns infra/config POCs; SE owns feature/perf POCs until perf/security checklist passes; then hand to CS. i'll document and share a short SOP.

leah: proposed top-5 playbooks to capture from wins/losses: 1) fallback routing playbook, 2) quantization & eval checklist, 3) cost-visibility how-to, 4) per-tenant cache controls, 5) SLA & enterprise onboarding checklist.

sam: playbooks should include an "escalation ask" template (impact, replication steps, suggested mitigations).

ana: action items: ana to compile top-5 and schedule triage with eng/product this week; leah+sam draft fallback playbook; priya draft eval checklist; matt upload billing sample; derek open ticket for partner KV requirements.

allhands-bot: Ana created task: #AH-2107 "Capture customer win/loss playbooks & asks" assigned to ana, leah, sam, priya. Link: https://rwd.inc/tasks/AH-2107 :spiral_calendar:

ana: closing this thread in 48h unless more comments. thanks all. :handshake:
